title: Commit canonical D&D SRD 5.1 generated rules pack
description:
﻿Generate and commit the canonical D&D SRD 5.1 rules-pack output from the vendored SRD 5.1 PDF.

Context:
- The SRD 5.1 PDF is now vendored and pinned under packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/.
- loreweaver-0m9.10 added generic rules-pack audit/diff tooling.
- loreweaver-0m9.6 adds committed-pack validation and a manual/path-gated verify:dnd5e-srd-pack command.
- The committed D&D SRD pack is still a seed pack and must be replaced by the canonical generated output once the importer can parse the real vendored PDF.
- loreweaver-0m9.5.20 tracks the importer bug where the current real-PDF import fails due section-anchor / vendored-PDF parsing issues.
- This bead should run after loreweaver-0m9.5.20 is fixed and after loreweaver-0m9.6 is merged.

Goal:
Make the committed D&D SRD 5.1 rules pack the durable canonical artifact generated from the vendored SRD 5.1 PDF, then make reproducibility verification strict.

Scope:
- Run the D&D SRD 5.1 importer against the vendored SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf.
- Replace the current seed generated pack under the committed D&D SRD rules-pack output location with the full generated pack.
- Review the generated output using the audit/diff tooling from loreweaver-0m9.10.
- Update committed-pack coverage/count/audit baselines from seed-pack values to reviewed full-pack values.
- Update verify:dnd5e-srd-pack expectations/documentation so the command is expected to exit 0 after canonical regeneration.
- Flip the path-gated SRD importer reproducibility workflow from informational to strict/failing, if that workflow exists.
- Keep changes focused on committing canonical generated output and its validation baselines.

Out of scope:
- Do not implement exact creature name-set validation; that remains loreweaver-0m9.5.14.
- Do not make broad parser improvements except for tiny fixes required to complete generation and already covered by loreweaver-0m9.5.20.
- Do not change SRD source vendoring/provenance policy.
- Do not change license attribution wording except to keep generated pack metadata aligned with the pinned source manifest.
- Do not introduce Pathfinder importer or Pathfinder coverage work.
- Do not hand-curate generated records.

Implementation guidance:
1. Confirm loreweaver-0m9.5.20 is complete and the importer can parse the vendored SRD 5.1 PDF.
2. Run the importer from the vendored source artifact into a temporary directory first.
3. Run rules-pack audit tooling against the temporary output.
4. Review counts by kind, suspicious findings, missing-field summaries, and manifest metadata.
5. If output contains obvious parser failures, stop and either fix a narrow importer bug or file a child bead. Do not commit known-bad canonical output.
6. Once output is reviewed, replace the committed D&D SRD generated pack with the generated output.
7. Update tests/baselines from seed-pack values to reviewed full-pack values.
8. Run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack and ensure it exits 0.
9. Change the path-gated SRD importer reproducibility workflow from informational/warning-only to strict failure on nonzero verify exit, if present.
10. Update docs/comments that previously described transitional states so they now describe the canonical steady state.

Acceptance criteria:
- The committed D&D SRD 5.1 rules pack is no longer the two-record seed pack.
- The committed generated pack is produced from the vendored SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf by the deterministic importer.
- Generated records validate successfully with validateRulesPack.
- Committed-pack tests cover full-pack reviewed baselines rather than seed-pack baselines.
- audit:rules-pack reports no suspicious findings, or only an explicitly documented reviewed baseline.
- verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exits 0 after canonical output is committed.
- diff:rules-pack or equivalent tooling shows no difference between temp regenerated output and committed output.
- Source provenance, license metadata, and attribution in the generated pack align with packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/manifest.json.
- The path-gated SRD importer reproducibility workflow, if present, is strict/failing rather than informational after this bead.
- npm run check passes.
- npm test passes.
- The PR notes include the generated record counts by kind and a short audit summary.
- No exact creature name-set validation is added in this bead.
notes: Canonical pack committed on branch loreweaver-1pw-canonical-srd-pack; PR #140 open for review. 834 records (319 spells, 296 creatures, 144 features, 15 conditions, 13 ancestries, 12 classes, 12 subclasses, 10 actions, 10 rules, 1 equipment, 1 feat, 1 table). audit:rules-pack 0 suspicious; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exits 0. Discovered+fixed real-PDF feat parser bug under child loreweaver-0m9.5.21 (required for clean output). Close on merge.
close_reason: Canonical SRD 5.1 pack (834 records) committed and merged in PR #140 (merge commit 86df579). audit:rules-pack 0 suspicious; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exits 0. Child feat-parser bug loreweaver-0m9.5.21 also fixed in the same PR.
